name: kurikulum-merdeka-asesmen-skills
description: Kurikulum Merdeka assessment skills for Indonesian schools: one self-contained skill per school level (PAUD/TK, SD/MI, SMP/MTs, SMA/MA, SMK/MAK), each covering teaching modules, stimulus design, assessment writing, item review, and exam/CBT conversion, grounded in Kemendikdasmen guidance.

interface.shortDescription: Assessment skills for Indonesian Kurikulum Merdeka, one per school level.
interface.longDescription: Five self-contained skills, one per school level. Determine the level first, then work inside that level's skill: teaching modules, stimulus, assessment writing, item review, and conversion in one place.
